craft_notes: Sthāyin: seed-joy. Close: stillness. Rejected: 'visualize' — killed: meditate kept; 'eternal' — 'ever' kept.

lines: Seed with nor head nor tail, abloom, mid-tithi set —
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat tithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśuṃ nityam abhyasyet

reads_against.argmap: Beginningless-endless blossoming seed mid-tithis in heart-lotus meditated; moon-ray ever practised.
c1_essence: Beginningless seed mid-tithis in heart-lotus; moon-ray practised.
